title: 第11章 历练的想法第12章 路上偶遇
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 为了对付拿下云霄阁，余东海对云霄阁的武技也研究过。这云霄剑法，他自然有所耳闻。
“对啊，我不是刚刚劈了一根废柴吗？”莫唯风呵呵笑道。
“刚才只是出其不意罢了，看你如何再劈我一次。”余东海再次挥剑进攻。
只是，就算他处处留意，依旧被莫唯风压制，身上又被莫唯风的剑气刺了好几道伤口。
余东海越战越是心惊。莫唯风的剑法，潇洒飘逸，来去无踪，防不胜防。再这样下去，自己最终只能落败。
打定主意，余东海动用全身灵力，全部注入手上的剑，使出破海剑法的大招，沧海一粟，一击把莫唯风击退。
“撤！”向青云宗众人大呼一声，余东海飞快地逃入云霄阁山门外不远的密林中。
莫唯风没想到余东海会突然逃走，想去追赶，却已然来不及。
“拦住他们，能杀多少就杀多少！”莫唯风大声下令。对来犯之敌，绝对不能手下留情。
青云宗众人看到宗主已经逃跑，毫无战意，都是四散奔逃。
又被云霄阁留下数十具尸体后，青云宗的人已经逃得一干二净了。
“哈哈，今天杀得真痛快！”大长老笑着走到莫唯风面前。
“大长老辛苦了！战况如何？”莫唯风问道。
大长老回道：“青云宗六大长老中，五长老被杀，三长老和六长老重伤逃走。普通长老死了二人，弟子有一百二十余人被杀。”
顿了一顿，大长老语气低沉，继续说：“至于我方，三长老和四长老重伤，执法殿殿主身死，弟子九十余人战死，重伤一百多人。”
莫唯风低头叹息：“两败俱伤。”
接着，他又下令：“传令，今日起，暂时封闭山门，谨防敌人来袭。”
“是！”众人忙着打扫战场，救治伤员。莫凡和雪儿跟在莫唯风、黎秋兰身后，回到阁主院子。
刚回到院子，黎秋兰就拉着莫凡坐在自己身边，急切地问道：“凡儿，你什么时候能修炼的，为何瞒着你爹和娘，让我们好生担心。”
莫唯风没做声，但也满脸疑惑地看着莫凡。
莫凡将想好的说辞一一道来：“并非孩儿有意欺瞒，我在一月前从武技殿得到一本功法，就试着修炼，没想到真的练成了。我也不知道自己能练到什么境界，就偷偷地先练着。万一只能练个开头就不能继续练下去，那就是给你们希望又带来失望。”
黎秋兰拉着莫凡的手，又慈爱地摸摸莫凡的头，“娘并非责怪你，娘是担心，万一修炼出了岔子，那该如何是好？再说，凡儿你是娘的心头肉，只要你能好好的，能不能修炼都不重要。有娘在你爹在，不会让人欺侮于你。”
莫唯风也轻轻点头。
莫凡心中一阵感动。黎秋兰和莫唯风对他的爱护，真的是没有一丝一毫的保留。
“凡儿，你现在是什么境界？”莫唯风问道。
“筑基八层。”
“什么？你才修炼了一个月，就筑基八层了？”莫唯风目瞪口呆，随即又高兴得连连拍大腿。黎秋兰也没好到哪里去，只有事前知道一些情况的雪儿脸色还算平静。
content_en:
In order to defeat Yunxiao Pavilion, Yu Donghai also studied Yunxiao Pavilion's martial arts. Naturally, he had heard of this Yunxiao Sword Technique.
"Yes, didn't I just chop up a piece of useless wood?" Mo Weifeng chuckled.
"It was just a surprise. Let's see how you hit me again." Yu Donghai swung his sword to attack again.
However, even though he paid attention everywhere, he was still suppressed by Mo Weifeng, and his body was stabbed with several wounds by Mo Weifeng's sword energy.
Yu Donghai became more frightened as he fought. Mo Weifeng's swordsmanship was free and elegant, coming and going without leaving a trace, making him impossible to guard against. If he continues like this, he will eventually lose.
After making up his mind, Yu Donghai used all his spiritual power to pour into the sword in his hand, and used the ultimate move of the Sea-breaking Sword Technique, which was a drop in the ocean and knocked Mo Weifeng back with one blow.
"Evacuate!" Yelling to everyone in the Qingyun Sect, Yu Donghai quickly fled into the dense forest not far from the gate of Yunxiao Pavilion.
Mo Weifeng didn't expect that Yu Donghai would suddenly escape. He wanted to chase him, but it was already too late.
"Stop them and kill as many as you can!" Mo Weifeng ordered loudly. We must show no mercy to the invading enemies.
When everyone in the Qingyun Sect saw that their sect leader had escaped, they all ran away without any intention of fighting.
After being left with dozens of corpses by Yunxiao Pavilion, all the people from the Qingyun Sect had escaped.
"Haha, it was so fun to kill today!" The elder smiled and walked up to Mo Weifeng.
"Thank you, Great Elder! How is the battle going?" Mo Weifeng asked.
The great elder replied: "Among the six elders of Qingyun Sect, the fifth elder was killed, the third elder and the sixth elder were seriously injured and escaped. Two ordinary elders died, and more than 120 disciples were killed."
After a pause, the great elder continued in a low tone: "As for our side, the third elder and the fourth elder were seriously injured, the master of the law enforcement hall died, more than ninety disciples died in the battle, and more than a hundred were seriously injured."
Mo Weifeng lowered his head and sighed: "Both sides will suffer."
Then, he ordered: "Send the order, starting today, the mountain gate will be temporarily closed to guard against enemy attacks."
"Yes!" Everyone was busy cleaning the battlefield and treating the wounded. Mo Fan and Xue'er followed Mo Weifeng and Li Qiulan back to the pavilion master's courtyard.
As soon as she returned to the courtyard, Li Qiulan pulled Mo Fan to sit next to her and asked eagerly: "Fan'er, when did you become able to practice? Why did you hide it from your father and mother and make us worry so much?"
Mo Weifeng said nothing, but looked at Mo Fan with confusion.
Mo Fan came up with the words he had thought of: "It's not that I meant to deceive. I got a skill book from the Martial Arts Hall a month ago and tried to practice it. I didn't expect that I could actually practice it. I didn't know what level I could practice, so I practiced it secretly. If I can only practice at the beginning but can't continue, it will give you hope and bring disappointment."
Li Qiulan took Mo Fan's hand and touched Mo Fan's head lovingly, "Mom is not blaming you, she is worried. What should I do if something goes wrong in my practice? Besides, Fan'er, you are my mother's heart. As long as you can do well, it doesn't matter whether you can practice or not. As long as your mother is here and your father is here, no one will bully you."
Mo Weifeng also nodded slightly.
Mo Fan was moved in his heart. Li Qiulan and Mo Weifeng really did not hold back the slightest bit of love for him.
"Fan'er, what state are you in now?" Mo Weifeng asked.
"Eight levels of foundation building."
"What? You've only been practicing for a month and you've already reached the eighth level of foundation building?" Mo Weifeng was stunned, and then he was so happy that he slapped his thigh again and again. Li Qiulan wasn't much better either. Only Xue'er, who knew some of the situation beforehand, looked calm.
